notes: Current website scope is ETF + major indices only. No individual-stock or delisted-stock market database is required. Public/no-key macro, rates, liquidity, CFTC positioning and public news context are refreshed automatically; exchange/vendor market-price history remains licensing-gated.

market_history_daily.scope: SPY, QQQ, DIA, S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, Nasdaq Composite, DJIA, S&P sector ETFs, verified Nasdaq sector trackers, verified Dow Jones U.S. sector indices
market_history_daily.public_rule: Only verified_publishable data may be written to docs/data/market_history.json
market_history_daily.fallback: Use the existing personal/local import path for non-display vendor data until a public-display licence is supplied.

market_snapshot.public_rule: Derived only from approved market history or another approved display source

sector_taxonomy.notes: S&P 500 11-sector ETFs are mapped. Nasdaq-100 and Dow Jones U.S. sector codes are added only after exact official mapping is verified.

official_public_bundle.provider: BLS / U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve Board / NY Fed / World Bank / OECD, with SEC/GDELT attempted fail-soft
official_public_bundle.refresh: daily GitHub Actions plus manual dispatch
official_public_bundle.rights: official/open public data only; source failures remain explicit

financial_conditions_and_liquidity.provider: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data / NY Fed / Federal Reserve public series
financial_conditions_and_liquidity.coverage: TGA operating cash, repo/reverse-repo operations, Fed assets, reserve balances, IORB and target range

futures_positioning.provider: U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission Public Reporting Environment
futures_positioning.coverage: selected financial futures positioning for major equity-index, U.S. dollar and 10Y Treasury contracts
futures_positioning.metric: contract counts and long-minus-short balances; not dollar flows or ETF flows

sec_identifiers.notes: SEC currently returns HTTP 403 to the hosted GitHub runner. Full ticker mapping is not required for the present ETF/index website scope, so this remains fail-soft rather than blocking publication.

news_recent.provider: GDELT DOC 2.0 plus Federal Reserve and BLS official RSS
news_recent.window: GDELT rolling 3 months; official RSS latest releases
news_recent.metric: GDELT aggregate topic coverage plus official release headlines/links only; no article bodies republished

news_deep_history.provider: GDELT bulk Event/GKG or licensed/archive source
news_deep_history.notes: DOC 2.0 is only a rolling recent window; deep history needs a separate bulk ingestion route rather than pretending the recent API covers old dates.
